fact: Researchers at Jamhuriya University of Science and Technology and partners built SomBERTa, the first monolingual Somali transformer language model, and two human-annotated Somali datasets, presented at the AfricaNLP 2025 Workshop.
title: Detection of Somali-written Fake News and Toxic Messages on the Social Media Using Transformer-based Language Models
publisher: AfricaNLP 2025 Workshop (ACL), via SNAIC Research Repository
